messages.subject: Installation INLA: Get "INLA_23.04.24.tar.gz" instead of laste version (2023-05-29)
parts:
Dear all,

I'm new user of INLA, however I didn't get far as I couldn't install INLA.
sessionInfo()
R version 4.3.1 (2023-06-16 ucrt) Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit) Running under: Windows 11 x64 (build 22621)
attached base packages: [1] grid stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods base other attached packages: [1] Rgraphviz_2.44.0 graph_1.78.0 BiocGenerics_0.46.0 loaded via a namespace (and not attached): [1] digest_0.6.33 fastmap_1.1.1 xfun_0.39 knitr_1.43 [5] htmltools_0.5.5 rmarkdown_2.23 stats4_4.3.1 cli_3.6.1 [9] compiler_4.3.1 rstudioapi_0.15.0 tools_4.3.1 evaluate_0.21 [13] yaml_2.3.7 BiocManager_1.30.21.1 rlang_1.1.1

Code used:
install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)

Message:
Installation du package dans ‘C:/Users/valer/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3’ (car ‘lib’ n'est pas spécifié) Warning in install.packages : impossible d'accéder à l'index de l'entrepôt https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.3: cannot open URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.3/PACKAGES' installation du package source ‘INLA’ trying URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/src/contrib/INLA_23.04.24.tar.gz' Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 91038966 bytes (86.8 MB) downloaded 86.8 MB * installing *binary* package 'INLA' ... cp: unknown option -- ) Try '/usr/bin/cp --help' for more information. ERROR: installing binary package failed * removing 'C:/Users/valer/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3/INLA' Warning in install.packages : l'installation du package ‘INLA’ a eu un statut de sortie non nul Les packages source téléchargés sont dans ‘C:\Users\valer\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpS21Shh\downloaded_packages’

I have also install the Rtools43.
Could you please help me? I don't know why it can't open the URL? I'm working on my personal computer and have administrative right on it.
Thanks in advance for your kind assistance.
Valérie

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Installation INLA: Get "INLA_23.04.24.tar.gz" instead of laste version (2023-05-29)
parts:
Dear Valérie,

INLA stable currently has no binaries for windows on R 4.3. Either switch to the testing versions (which have windows binaries for R 4.3) or downgrade R to 4.2. Another option is to try to install INLA from source.

Best regards,

ir. Thierry Onkelinx
